title: Four
tagline: Drop. Line up. Four in a row.
factsZh: 悔棋 + 提示 + 自动保存

lines.en: Seven columns. Six rows. One line of four.
Four. A tiny game for a big table.
lines.zh: 四子棋。给一大家子的小游戏。

lines.en: Drop a disc and let it fall. Red starts.
lines.zh: 落下一枚棋子，红方先手。

lines.en: Build your line while you block theirs.
lines.zh: 一边连线，一边堵住对方。

lines.en: Four AI levels, from gentle Companion to a five-move Hard.
lines.zh: 四档 AI，从温和陪玩到五层搜索的挑战。

lines.en: Two players on one screen, or a phone joins over Wi-Fi.
lines.zh: 两人同屏，或者手机连同一 Wi-Fi 加入。

lines.en: Hints, undo, autosave and a family record.
lines.zh: 提示、悔棋、自动保存和家庭战绩。
